plan: The optimal bidding strategy in a second-price auction is to bid slightly below your true value. This minimizes the chance of overpaying and maximizes the chance of winning when the second-highest bid is below your value. Given my value is $16, I will bid $15.9. This allows me to win the auction if the second-highest bid is less than $15.9, securing a profit.

My value is $18. I want to win if and only if my value exceeds the second-highest bid. A good strategy is to bid slightly above my expected value to increase my chances of winning while still ensuring a positive profit. I will bid $17.9. This allows me to win if the second highest bid is less than $17.9, guaranteeing a profit.

Since my value is $26, which is outside the range of possible values for the other bidders (0-20), I should win the auction as long as I bid slightly above 20. I will bid $20.1 to ensure I win and maximize my profit, which will be $26 - $20.1 = $5.9.
